baseline-v1.description: Bounded Pi coding agent with explicit inspection and final diff requirements.
instructions: Inspect the repository before proposing a change.
Make the smallest correct code and test change needed to resolve the issue.
Run focused relevant tests when feasible.
Before finishing, inspect git diff and leave the fix in the worktree.

reproduce-diff-verify-v1.description: Candidate policy that requires a reproduction-first loop before editing.
instructions: First locate the affected code and reproduce or otherwise validate the reported behavior.
Then make the smallest correct code and test change needed to resolve the issue.
Run focused relevant tests after editing.
Before finishing, inspect git diff; do not finish without either a diff or a clearly recorded blocker.
